content.text:
VERDICT: LGTM

The new `countOwnersByCity` is a clean, additive mirror of the existing `countOwnersByName` sitting directly above it — same null-guard, same `findAll().stream().filter().count()` idiom, same Javadoc style, same `@Transactional(readOnly = true)` annotation. It belongs in the service layer, and the interface declaration follows the ordering of its siblings.

The controller check is placed naturally alongside the other pre-save conflict checks in `addOwner`, returning `409 CONFLICT` consistently with the adjacent telephone/household guards. Logic lives in the right unit (count in the service, HTTP decision in the controller), nothing is duplicated beyond the deliberate consistency with the existing count method, and neither class is becoming a catch-all. A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
